eventTypes.summary: The command accepted its request; the first record of every stream.
The resolved request: mode, model, variant, seed (a decimal string) and the planned item or segment count.
The engine is ready to accept work.
The request waits behind another for the engine.
A take started; the record carries its generationID.
A streamed audio chunk was produced (counts and timings only, never PCM).
Coalesced progress of the current take, batch or project.
Coalesced progress of a model download.
The take's Fast QC verdict and flags.
A take's output file was published atomically.
A take failed; data carries the error object.
A warning, with the same code and message as the envelope's warnings.
A diagnostic line under --verbose; never text, transcripts or private paths.
The final record of every stream; data is the command's envelope.
